timed_region.probs: execute the circuit and materialize the full 2^n probability vector
timed_region.counts: execute the circuit and return the simulator's own shot result (PRISM-Q's count map, Aer's Result, qsim's measurement array, Stim's bit-packed sample array, quimb's sample list)
timed_region.expval: execute the circuit and return every requested expectation value (PRISM-Q's expectation_values, Aer's saved marginal probabilities over each observable's qubits, quimb's local_expectation per observable); quimb's tensor network finds a fresh contraction path for every observable inside the timed call, and quimb's CircuitMPS applies the gates inside it
timed_region.stats: compile the sampler and draw every shot into the simulator's packed shot buffer (PRISM-Q's compile_measurements and CompiledSampler::try_sample_bulk_packed, Stim's compile_sampler and sample with bit_packed=True), in buffers of at most 64 MiB; reducing each buffer to the selected statistics happens outside the timer on both sides

validation.probs: total variation distance against the fp64 reference simulator's vector; Aer is the reference only within 1e-08 of QuEST where QuEST ran on the row
validation.counts: exact binomial test per statistic against the cone reference, two-sample z-test against another simulator where the cone is too wide; Bonferroni family-wise alpha 1e-3
validation.stats: exact binomial test per statistic against the cone reference, two-sample z-test against another simulator where the cone is too wide; Bonferroni family-wise alpha 1e-3, on the statistics and shot total the simulator returns
validation.expval: absolute difference per value against the cone reference (<Z> = 1 - 2p, <ZZ> = 1 - 2 P(odd)), against a simulator of another family where the cone is too wide; tolerance 1e-08 for fp64 and 1e-05 for fp32 simulators; the bond-cap sweep reports the largest error without a pass or fail
validation.stored_outputs: gzipped outputs of the reference candidates under `outputs/`, named by `output_file`
